source: User-verified against official NSE Indices sources (replaces the prior UNVERIFIED_BEST_EFFORT list built from WebSearch snippets and trained knowledge -- this environment's outbound network access to niftyindices.com/Wikipedia/Dhan remains EGRESS_BLOCKED, so the user performed the verification directly and supplied this list).
action_required: This list is valid through the close of trading on 2026-09-29 only. Re-verify against https://niftyindices.com/IndexConstituent/ind_nifty50list.csv (or another authoritative source) before or at each NSE Indices reconstitution -- nominally the last trading day of March and September, but ad hoc changes also occur -- and whenever the pending change below takes effect.

pending_index_changes.detail: WIPRO exits and BSE (BSE Ltd) enters the NIFTY 50, effective after the close of 2026-09-29 / from 2026-09-30 onward.
pending_index_changes.note: Metadata/documentation only. BSE is deliberately NOT included in the active 'symbols' list below, and WIPRO is deliberately still included, because this list represents the composition in force through 2026-09-29. Do not move BSE into 'symbols' before 2026-09-30; do not remove WIPRO before then either.

known_gaps_between_this_list_and_the_liv.SBILIFE: Verified current NIFTY 50 constituent (SBI Life Insurance) but absent from the live PSYGRID /public/live.json universe as of this file's last check. 50.py will correctly report it as unavailable rather than fabricate data for it.
known_gaps_between_this_list_and_the_liv.SHRIRAMFIN: Verified current NIFTY 50 constituent (Shriram Finance) but absent from the live PSYGRID universe as of this file's last check. Same handling as SBILIFE.
known_gaps_between_this_list_and_the_liv.TMPV: Tata Motors demerged into separate passenger-vehicle (TMPV) and commercial-vehicle entities; the PSYGRID universe carries TMPV, not the legacy TATAMOTORS symbol, so this list uses TMPV.
